linkedin.title: Your client asks why traffic dropped. Here's your reply.
linkedin.caption:
This week, a lot of agencies will get the same message from a client: "Why did our Google traffic drop?"

Most likely it's Google's November core update, which started rolling out on 10 Nov and takes about two weeks.

Here's a reply that keeps you calm and in control:

→ Step 1. Rankings move during the rollout. We wait until it's finished before reading anything into the data, as Google recommends.
→ Step 2. Meanwhile, we rule out technical causes: indexing, robots.txt, broken pages, speed. An accidental noindex looks exactly like an update drop.
→ Step 3. Then we compare before and after, page by page, in Search Console.

What we don't do: mass rewrites, deleting pages or changing URLs in a panic.
